item.tib: sku gsum rig 'dus dran pa drag phur dam sri kun sgrol gnam lcags dbal 'khor gsang ba dgongs 'dus las sngon 'gro bsnyen pa khog dbub rin chen phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pa'i dbal phur gsang don dgongs 'dus kyi sngon 'gro bsnyen pa'i bon gyi zab don mkha' 'gro 'od ldan nyi 'bar gyis nyag bon gang sprul tshe dbang 'gyur med la snyan du brgyud pa de dgongs pa'i brda las gang shar ma nor phab pa'o//
